prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: Daggerfall Unity NPC portrait speech-mouth atlas
Primary request: Create one clean 3-by-3 atlas of the same portrait's lower 64-by-29 face half, based only on the supplied mouth reference grid. The full canvas must preserve exact 64:29 aspect ratio and contain nine equal cells with no gutters or labels, each showing the complete lower half at the supplied 8x pixel-art scale. Row-major poses are A B C / D E F / G H X. Preserve lower face, nose, cheeks, chin, hair, neck and background alignment in every cell. Neutral A and X must reproduce original relaxed closed brown lips exactly.
Input images: Image 1 is the only edit reference and supplies the exact face, crop, palette, lip scale, and native pixel-art anatomy.
Subject: Same adult woman portrait, same facial identity, mouth centered at same native coordinates and same lip width and proportions as reference.
Style/medium: Muted pixel art with crisp native pixel clusters, matching reference scale and soft pixel-art shading.
Color palette: Preserve warm muted tan skin and soft brown lips, softly blended pixel-art contrast. Teeth are restrained warm ivory. Mouth cavities are dark muted brown. No lipstick red, orange skin, bright white teeth blocks, or exaggerated contrast.
Constraints: Keep content restricted to the full lower-half mouth reference crop in all nine cells; do not create or paste a full face. Change mouth pose only; preserve all other features and background. Keep original lip scale; do not widen face or mouth. Use these exact Rhubarb pose meanings:
A: closed lightly pressured P/B/M lips.
B: narrow horizontal opening, nearly together teeth, consonants/EE.
C: medium relaxed unrounded EH/AE opening.
D: wide vertical AA opening, larger than C.
E: slightly rounded AO/ER opening, no wider than C.
F: small forward pucker UW/OW/W; not tooth biting.
G: upper teeth touching lower lip F/V; not a wide vowel or pucker.
H: tongue raised behind upper teeth L, opening between C and D; tiny tongue may be invisible at native resolution.
X: relaxed closed idle.
Keep neutral emotional tension across all poses. No text, labels, borders, or added elements.
